v3.1.0: Added Voluspa luxury candles (94 products). Now 5 categories: Flowers + Chocolates + Jewelry + Candles + Supplements. 1,833 total products across 9 merchants.

v3.0.0: MAJOR - Added GODIVA chocolates (159 products) and Gorjana jewelry (236 products). Now multi-category: Flowers + Chocolates + Jewelry + Supplements. 1,739 total gift products across 8 merchants.
v2.3.0: Final polish - comprehensive summary table, all regions tested and working, quick copy-paste examples, 707 lines of documentation
v2.2.0: Added FlowerChimp Malaysia (85 products). Now 1,058 flowers across 5 florists in 4 countries + 286 supplements. Total 1,344 gift products.
v2.1.0: Added Malaysia (BloomThis, 127 products). Now 5 regions: US, Singapore, Australia, Malaysia, Global. 1,259 flowers + 286 supplements.
v2.0.0: MAJOR - Added Singapore (Far East Flora, 593 products) and Australia (Floraly, 148 products). Now covers US, SG, AU with 846 flower products + 286 supplements. Full geo routing.
